import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
base=bpy.data.objects.get('OFICIAL | Entrada superior | lintel')
if not base: raise RuntimeError('lintel missing')
theta=base.rotation_euler.z
ex=Vector((math.cos(theta),math.sin(theta),0.0))
ey=Vector((-math.sin(theta),math.cos(theta),0.0))
origin=Vector((base.location.x,base.location.y,0.0))
names=['OFICIAL | Entrada superior | fachada esquerda','OFICIAL | Entrada superior | fachada direita','OFICIAL | Entrada superior | lintel','OFICIAL | Entrada superior | cobertura','OFICIAL | Entrada superior | parede lateral A','OFICIAL | Entrada superior | parede lateral B']
allpts=[]
for n in names:
 o=bpy.data.objects.get(n)
 if not o:
  print('MISSING',n); continue
 pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
 allpts += pts
 us=[(p-origin).dot(ex) for p in pts]; vs=[(p-origin).dot(ey) for p in pts]; zs=[p.z for p in pts]
 print(f'{n}\n U=[{min(us):.4f},{max(us):.4f}] width={max(us)-min(us):.4f}\n V=[{min(vs):.4f},{max(vs):.4f}] width={max(vs)-min(vs):.4f}\n Z=[{min(zs):.4f},{max(zs):.4f}] height={max(zs)-min(zs):.4f}')
us=[(p-origin).dot(ex) for p in allpts];vs=[(p-origin).dot(ey) for p in allpts];zs=[p.z for p in allpts]
print(f'UNION U=[{min(us):.4f},{max(us):.4f}] V=[{min(vs):.4f},{max(vs):.4f}] Z=[{min(zs):.4f},{max(zs):.4f}]')
print('THETA_DEG',math.degrees(theta))
